message.content:
You are skeptic #2. A WCAG/§4 audit of Heard's "admin-activity" screen produced this finding. Independently verify it by READING the cited code. Try to REFUTE it — default to real=false if the code already handles it, the claim is a stylistic nit, or it's not actually reachable by a user.

FILE: /Users/taha/Claude projects/TEWW apps/Therapy (Heard)/components/ui/DataTable.tsx
LOCATION: Line 68
RULE: 5
TITLE: Sort announcement uses hard-coded English string instead of i18n
DETAIL: The sort state announcement ('Sorted by {col}, ascending/descending') is hard-coded in English in the DataTable component at line 68. This violates rule §9 (copy via messages/en.json). If the app ever supports other languages, this live-region announcement will not be localized, breaking the accessible experience for non-English speakers.
SUGGESTION: Move the announcement strings to messages/en.json under an 'ui' namespace, e.g., 'ui.sortedBy': 'Sorted by {column}, {direction}'. Import t() in DataTable and use: t('ui.sortedBy', { column: col.header, direction: dir === 'asc' ? t('ui.ascending') : t('ui.descending') }).

Return real=true ONLY if this is a genuine, actionable accessibility/polish gap that a fix would meaningfully improve.

Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". - code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.

- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. # CLAUDE.md — "Heard"

Conventions and guardrails for building this app. **Read `SPEC.md` for the full spec and `BUILD_PLAN.md` for the milestone order.** This file holds the rules you must follow on every change.

## What this is
A two-sided marketplace where customers pay to talk with companion listeners who are all legally blind or visually impaired. Non-clinical companionship — **never** therapy. Accessibility and the dignity of providers are the whole point of the product.

## Stack
Next.js (App Router) · TypeScript (`strict`) · Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Storage) · Tailwind CSS · Zod · Vitest + React Testing Library + Playwright · deploy to Vercel + Supabase.

## Golden rules (do not violate)
1. **Accessibility is non-negotiable.** WCAG 2.2 AA minimum, AAA contrast on body text. Keyboard-operable, visible focus, semantic HTML, labeled controls, no state by color alone. A screen isn't done until it passes axe in tests. See `SPEC.md` §10.
2. **External services only through adapters.** Reach payments/calls/background-checks via `lib/integrations/*/index.ts` (`getPayments()`, `getCalls()`, `getBackgroundCheck()`). Never import `mock.ts`/`real.ts` directly; never call Stripe/Zoom/Checkr SDKs outside `real.ts`. Default mode is `mock`.
3. **All money is integer cents.** No floats for currency. All pricing/commission math lives in `lib/pricing.ts` and nowhere else. Commission comes from `PLATFORM_COMMISSION_RATE` (config), never a literal.
4. **Security: RLS on every table.** Customers/providers touch only their own rows; public reads only approved-provider public fields; admin sees all. The `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` is server-only — never shipped to the client, never in a client component.
5. **Validate at the boundary.** Every server action and route handler validates input with Zod and checks the caller's role/ownership before doing work.
6. **Server-first.** Prefer React Server Components + Server Actions; use client components only for genuinely interactive UI. No secrets in client bundles.
7. **All user-facing copy goes through `messages/en.json`** (i18n-ready) — no hard-coded strings in components.
8. **Safety framing in the product.** Every page carries the "companionship, not therapy — crisis support" affordance. Don't add anything that implies medical/mental-health treatment.

## Conventions
- Components: PascalCase files; one component per file; design-system primitives in `components/ui` (Button, Field, Card, Dialog, …) used everywhere for consistent a11y.
- Styling: Tailwind core utilities + the design tokens from `../Interactive_Prototype_Design_Brief.md` (warm & trustworthy palette, 18px+ body, ≥48px tap targets).
- Data access: queries in `lib/db/queries.ts`; Zod schemas in `lib/validation/schemas.ts`.
- Errors: never swallow; return typed results and show friendly, accessible error states.
- Tests live in `tests/`; add/extend tests with every feature.

## Commands
```
npm run dev            # local dev
npm run build          # production build
npm run lint           # eslint + prettier
npm run typecheck      # tsc --noEmit
npm run test           # vitest (unit + component)
npm run test:e2e       # playwright
supabase db reset      # apply migrations + seed (6 sample providers)
```

## Definition of done (every feature/PR)
- TypeScript passes (`strict`), lint clean.
- Keyboard-navigable + axe a11y check passes for any new/changed screen.
- New logic has unit tests; pricing/accounting changes have explicit cases (blocks, overage, commission, tips, rounding).
- Inputs Zod-validated; RLS/ownership respected; no secrets client-side.
- User-facing strings in `messages/en.json`.

## Out of scope right now
Real Stripe/Zoom/Checkr calls, moderation/reporting admin UI (table + minimal report hook only), native mobile, subscriptions. Keep schema/adapters ready so these don't need a rewrite. See `SPEC.md` §12.
